record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only training-frequency input modulation from 0.02 to 0.025: use 1 + 0.025*tanh(standardized log1p training item counts). The regressions at 0.01 and 0.04 motivate a small increase near the incumbent. Keep padding and mask scales at 1, save scales in each checkpoint, and preserve embeddings, topology, history, readout, loss and optimizer. Train one independent BERT4Rec model per category.
